subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Departure: June 15th at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport, New York. Arrival: June 15th at 11:45 PM at Charles de Gaulle Airport, Paris. Please ensure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for check-in procedures. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
